title: 2000 Upper Deck Ovation - #31 Randy Moss Vikings
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2000 Upper Deck Ovation sports trading card features Randy Moss, a former Minnesota Viking player who went on to play for the New England Patriots. The card is a part of the base set and has the card number 31. It is perfect for any NFL fan or collector who is looking to add a card of one of the most iconic players in football history to their collection. 

This card is a must-have for any serious collector or fan of the sport. It is an authentic Upper Deck card from the 2000 season and features no autograph or special designations. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this piece of sports history to your collection today!
